finalists.label: Toxocariasis
finalists.why: It has the strongest specific evidence, including exposure to dogs and cats, pica, and pending Toxocara serology.

finalists.label: Pericarditis
finalists.why: It has multiple specific findings, including minor anterior chest trauma, mild tenderness over the sternum, and a moderate circumferential pericardial effusion.

frontier_selector.why: Toxocariasis is chosen due to its unique combination of exposure history, symptoms like eosinophilia, and specific pending serology, which together provide a more distinctive and less common set of findings compared to the more general signs of pericarditis.
